description: Start a study of a watched rival: `research` (desk research from the web) or `walkthrough` (an agent visits the product in a browser), with optional `lenses` and a `brief`. It costs credits: the dialog says the estimate and the cap first. The report lands on Documents and its findings on the rival; read it with competitor `study`. `cancel` stops a study that is still running (`study`).

brief.description: for start: what you want to know, in your words

company.description: the company id (list_companies); not needed when you have one company, asked for otherwise

competitor.description: for start: the rival’s id (from competitors)

lenses.description: for start: what to look at; the kind’s usual lenses when left out

name: study_competitor
title: Study a competitor
